verdict.rationale: Ashby advertises 250+ integrations that include post-hire tools, and an API-based bi-directional sync with Workday, an HRIS. That implies hire data can move into an HRIS without re-entry. No evidence ties a signed offer to triggering onboarding or confirms which fields carry over. Missing for 10: explicit offer-signed-to-HRIS handoff workflow, payroll integrations, documented field mapping of new-hire data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
